notes:
{幸福|こうふく} is a formal word for happiness.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {幸福|こうふく}な + noun (happy...)
- {幸福|こうふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel happiness)
- {幸福|こうふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}い{求|もと}める→追い求める：noentry⟧ (to pursue happiness)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {幸福|こうふく}⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (happiness level)
- {幸福|こうふく}⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (sense of happiness)
- ⟦{至福|しふく}→至福：17403_shifuku⟧ (supreme bliss)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {幸福|こうふく}: happiness (formal, philosophical)
- ⟦{幸|しあわ}せ→幸せ：02368_shiawase⟧: happiness (common, everyday)
- ⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧: joy, pleasure

NOTE: {幸福|こうふく} is more literary and often used in philosophical or abstract contexts.
